name: Diver's kit
body:
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 7
Price 121 gp; Weight 38 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit is ideal for adventurers who venture into sunken ruins or half-flooded temples, and includes an air bladderUE, a common buoyUE, 30 feet of chain, a fishing net, a glass bottle, a pound of soap, three sunrods, a waterproof bagUE, and a waterproof hooded lanternUE with 3 flasks of oil.
